description: A research brief on one x402 category, $0.50 a section: demand (repeat calls week by week, sweeps left out), prices (p10, median and p90 by week, price bands, GET against POST), survival (new listings still listed one to four weeks on), rivals (the listings with the most payers) and proof (what each Fair Offer proof is worth at the median price). Markdown, every table also as JSON. The table of contents is free at /contents. Price: $0.50 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.50 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

chapter.description: Which chapter. demand: Repeat calls in 30 days week by week, sweeps left out, and how concentrated they are. prices: p10, median and p90 week by week, the price bands, and GET against POST. survival: New listings still listed one to four weeks on, and four-week survival by price band. rivals: The ten listings with the most payers: price, method, calls, repeat use and Fair Offer block. proof: What each Fair Offer proof and manipulation is worth at the category's median price.
